title: Distributed load control method and system on power demand side based on federated learning

pse.problem: Tight electricity supply and demand situation with increasing difficulty for supply-side regulation. Need for a method to ensure power supply while utilizing and mining value of load resources.
pse.solution_function: Collect encrypted load status information from adjustable load units, jointly train distributed load control model using edge computing power at load terminals, and apply the trained model to ensure participation of multiple loads on demand side in control, promoting intelligent interactive mode of power grid operation.
pse.solution_structure: Load terminal, adjustable load unit, encrypted load status information, federated learning-based distributed load control model.
pse.solution_implementation: Collect load status information, encrypt the data, upload to terminal, jointly train and apply the distributed load control model using the encrypted data at each terminal in a decentralized manner.
pse.effect: Enhanced reliability and safety of grid operation, increased participation of distributed load resources in market interaction, and improved power grid control capability.
